content_fields.title: Restrict network access to the database server
content_fields.description: Restrict network reachability of the database server.
content_fields.guidance: The database should be reachable only from the application tier, on an internal network segment, never published to a host interface or the internet.
content_fields.found: The database uses `expose` rather than a published port, which is sound, but it shares the default network with every other container and no internal-only network is declared.
content_fields.missing: Network segmentation policy at the platform level beyond what Compose expresses.
content_fields.conclusion: Meaningful network restriction is enforced by the platform's network policy; the compose-level change is tracked separately under the container network isolation countermeasure.
content_fields.action: The platform team should place the database on an internal segment with explicit ingress rules.
